words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 你想吃什么？(Nǐ xiǎng chī shénme?) — What would you like to eat?
我想喝一杯冰水。(Wǒ xiǎng hē yì bēi bīngshuǐ.) — I want to drink a glass of ice water.
多喝水对身体好。(Duō hē shuǐ duì shēntǐ hǎo.) — Drinking more water is good for health.
中国人很喜欢喝绿茶。(Zhōngguórén hěn xǐhuan hē lǜchá.) — Chinese people like drinking green tea.
每天早上我都会喝咖啡。(Měitiān zǎoshang wǒ dōu huì hē kāfēi.) — Every morning I drink coffee.
我要一碗米饭。(Wǒ yào yì wǎn mǐfàn.) — I want a bowl of rice.
这里的牛肉面条很有名。(Zhèlǐ de niúròu miàntiáo hěn yǒumíng.) — The beef noodles here are famous.
四川菜味道很辣。(Sìchuān cài wèidao hěn là.) — Sichuan cuisine is very spicy.
每天吃水果对身体有益。(Měitiān chī shuǐguǒ duì shēntǐ yǒuyì.) — Eating fruit every day is good for health.
红苹果很甜。(Hóng píngguǒ hěn tián.) — Red apples are very sweet.
我不常吃肥肉。(Wǒ bù cháng chī féiròu.) — I don't often eat fatty meat.
宫保鸡丁是著名中国菜。(Gōngbǎo jīdīng shì zhùmíng Zhōngguó cài.) — Kung Pao chicken is a famous Chinese dish.
这份牛肉很鲜嫩。(Zhè fèn niúròu hěn xiānnèn.) — This beef is very tender.
年夜饭通常会吃鱼。(Niányèfàn tōngcháng huì chī yú.) — Fish is usually eaten for New Year's Eve dinner.
西红柿炒鸡蛋做法简单。(Xīhóngshì chǎo jīdàn zuòfǎ jiǎndān.) — Tomato scrambled eggs is simple to make.
睡前喝杯温牛奶有助于睡眠。(Shuìqián hē bēi wēn niúnǎi yǒuzhùyú shuìmián.) — Drinking warm milk before sleep aids rest.
这家饭馆的菜肴很地道。(Zhè jiā fànguǎn de càiyáo hěn dìdào.) — The dishes at this restaurant are authentic.
这个饺子真好吃！(Zhè gè jiǎozi zhēn hǎochī!) — These dumplings are really delicious!
这碗热汤非常好喝。(Zhè wǎn rè tāng fēicháng hǎohē.) — This bowl of hot soup is delicious to drink.
我们可以点菜了吗？(Wǒmen kěyǐ diǎncài le ma?) — May we order our food now?

words.English Meaning: to pay the bill / check please
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 服务员，我们要买单。(Fúwùyuán, wǒmen yào mǎidān.) — Server, we would like to pay the bill.
你会用筷子吃饭吗？(Nǐ huì yòng kuàizi chīfàn ma?) — Do you know how to eat with chopsticks?
请给我一个空碗。(Qǐng gěi wǒ yí gè kōng wǎn.) — Please give me an empty bowl.
杯子里有热水。(Bēizi lǐ yǒu rè shuǐ.) — There is hot water in the cup.
早餐我吃了两个肉包子。(Zǎocān wǒ chī le liǎng gè ròubāozi.) — For breakfast I ate two meat steamed buns.
